https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: * Billing units: Depending on the service, charges are based on tokens, characters, duration, images, voices, or requests. See the relevant pricing table for the exact unit.
https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: * Payment: API usage charges are deducted from your account balance.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: * Rates: Rates vary by model, API, and configuration. For example, LLM input length and service tier, or video output resolution, can affect pricing.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: 1. The billing item is token count; the token-to-character ratio varies slightly depending on the usage scenario, subject to actual consumption
https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: 2. Token to English word ratio (estimate): approximately 750 English words consume 1000 tokens

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: Explore MiniMax model and tool pricing, choose an Audio Subscription or Video Package, or learn about billing.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: Find answers to common questions about pay-as-you-go billing, Audio Subscription plans, and Video Packages. See the relevant pricing tables for exact prices and included features.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: For each billing item, multiply actual usage by the applicable unit price. First, convert usage to the unit listed in the pricing table. For example, if a price is listed per million tokens, divide the token count by 1,000,000 before multiplying by the price. If a request includes multiple billing items, add their costs together.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: H3 video output and input media are billed separately. Images beyond the free allowance incur an additional charge. Input video is billed based on its duration and the output resolution. If you regenerate a video, the input media from the original task is billed again. See the video pricing tables for the applicable rates.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: MiniMax offers pay-as-you-go billing, Audio Subscription plans, and Video Packages. Choose a billing option based on the models you use, how much you expect to use them, and for how long.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: Priority gives your requests priority access for faster responses and improved reliability. It costs 1.5 times the Standard rate. To enable it, set `service_tier` to `priority`. See the LLM pricing tables for the rates that apply to each input length.
https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: Regenerate a previously produced 768P video into 2K, billed per second of the regenerated output.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: See Model Pricing and Tool Pricing for individual rates. Audio Subscription plans and Video Packages are also available for supported models. To compare these options, see [Payment Methods](#guides/compare).

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: Starting August 20, 2026, the paid APIs (Music Generation and Lyrics Generation) will no longer be available to new users; existing paying users can continue to use the current API services. The free music generation APIs (Music-3.0-free, Music-2.6-free, music-cover-free) will be discontinued.
https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: The input materials used in the original 768P generation task will be billed again.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: Unused video points expire with the package and do not roll over. Your video point balance resets to zero when the package expires. For Audio Subscription plans, see the subscription table for available terms, monthly audio points, and plan features. Rate limits and other included features are listed in the relevant pricing tables.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: When API-vlm is called through M Plan, usage deducts from the included M Plan quota according to its pay-as-you-go price. If the included quota is exhausted and purchased Credits are available, additional usage can be automatically covered by purchased Credits.
https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: With pay-as-you-go billing, you use standard Open Platform API keys and pay from your account balance based on usage. All prices are in USD.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: \* Priority provides priority admission for faster response times and improved request reliability. Set `service_tier` to `priority` to enable it. Pricing is 1.5x standard.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: 🔔 **Pricing Update Notice** — Effective July 22, 2026, the API-vlm price will be adjusted to $0.01 per call. Accordingly, the token quota deducted per API-vlm call under M Plan subscriptions will decrease, allowing the same plan to support more calls. API endpoints and model capabilities remain unchanged — no code changes required.
